impact.text: The vulnerability enables direct theft of all ETH and ERC‑20 tokens held by `TrailsRouter` by any EOA, with no privileged roles required.

precondition_sources.text: TrailsRouter holds ETH or ERC-20 tokens, e.g. via direct receive() or a prior flow leaving funds on the router.
Attacker crafts an aggregate3Value payload whose subcalls transfer the router's token balance to the attacker and send the router's ETH balance to the attacker.

intent_sources.text: Dangerous entrypoints that delegate to Multicall3 and can spend router-held balances must be restricted to delegatecall-only execution.
Public callers must not be able to spend router-held ETH and ERC-20 balances through arbitrary aggregate3Value subcalls.
